design_system.rationale: The user has strictly defined a Bloomberg Terminal aesthetic. This requires prioritizing data density, absolute structural clarity, and high-contrast monospaced typography over decorative whitespace or organic shapes. Aesthetics are stripped down to pure functional utility.

layout_and_spacing.density: High. Use compact padding (p-2 to p-4). Screen real estate must be maximized for dense data display.
layout_and_spacing.borders: Visible skeleton. Use 1px solid borders (#1a2040) around all distinct panels and grid items to define boundaries sharply.
layout_and_spacing.surfaces: Flat, solid colors only. No glassmorphism, no drop shadows, no gradients.

components.panels: border border-[#1a2040] bg-[#0a0e1a] flex flex-col h-full overflow-hidden
components.tables: w-full text-left text-xs. th with border-b border-[#1a2040] text-[#8a9bc2] font-normal py-1.5 px-2. td py-1.5 px-2 tabular-nums.
components.buttons: Square edges, dense padding (px-3 py-1). Action buttons (Close, TP, SL, BEP) use 1px solid border matching their semantic color (e.g., border-[#00d4ff] text-[#00d4ff] hover:bg-[#00d4ff]/10).
components.tabs: Flat layout. Active tab gets text-[#00d4ff] and border-b-2 border-[#00d4ff]. Inactive gets text-[#8a9bc2].
components.tags: bg-[#0f1423] border border-[#1a2040] text-[#e0e8ff] text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-none uppercase
components.signal_log: Terminal-style feed. bg-[#0a0e1a] border border-[#1a2040] p-2 overflow-y-auto font-mono text-xs space-y-1. Success lines in #00ff88, info in #00d4ff, errors in #ff3366.

interactions_and_motion.hover: Instant or very fast (100ms) transitions. Subtle background shifts to #171d30.
interactions_and_motion.data_update: Critical: Implement CSS keyframe 'flash' animations (green/red background tint fading out over 500ms) for real-time WebSocket tick updates on active positions and PNL.

media.notes: Zero imagery. Dashboard relies entirely on typography, color, geometric layouts, and pure functional data visualization.

testing.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attributes formatted as kebab-case-role (e.g., data-testid='close-position-btn-btc').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build strictly in React (.js/.jsx) with Tailwind CSS.
Adhere strictly to the provided hex codes. Do NOT use default Tailwind colors (e.g., slate, blue, green) unless they perfectly match.
Ensure 'JetBrains Mono' is imported globally and forced on the entire application (body, buttons, inputs).
Structure the dashboard using CSS Grid to fill the viewport (h-screen) with a rigid panel layout, avoiding full-page window scrolling.
Use Shadcn/UI primitives if needed, but strip ALL default rounded corners (rounded-md/lg -> rounded-none) and shadow effects to maintain the terminal aesthetic.
Charts should be integrated using lightweight libraries like Recharts, styled with transparent backgrounds, cyan/blue lines, and green/red candles. Remove grid axes lines or color them faint #1a2040.
Signal logs must look like a raw console/terminal output. Active positions must auto-calculate visual PNL strictly in #00ff88 (Profit) and #ff3366 (Loss).
